profile.name: Peter Elishea Awad
profile.title: Frontend Developer
profile.summary: Frontend Developer building production web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Delivered a live booking platform with payment gateway and IoT integration, corporate websites, and admin, ERP, financial, and education dashboards (including bilingual Arabic/English). Strong in API integration with React Query, reusable component systems with Tailwind CSS and ShadCN/UI, and responsive, performance-focused UI. Comfortable working with designers and backend engineers in Agile teams, locally and remotely.

highlights: Build and maintain production Next.js and React applications in TypeScript, including a booking platform, corporate websites, and admin and financial dashboards.
Created a reusable component library with Tailwind CSS and ShadCN/UI to speed up feature delivery and keep UI consistent across projects.
Integrated REST APIs and managed server state, caching, and async data flows with React Query.
Worked in Agile sprints with designers and backend developers to ship responsive, maintainable features.
Applied performance and accessibility practices: optimised rendering, responsive layouts, and clean component architecture.
Delivered responsive web interfaces for independent clients using React, Tailwind CSS, and modern JavaScript.
Implemented form validation and state management with React Hook Form, Zod, and React Query.
Built reusable UI components and integrated APIs for dynamic web applications.

projects.name: Luca Stay
projects.subtitle: Booking Platform
projects.description: Live booking platform with suite and workspace reservation flows, payment gateway, and IoT integration.
highlights: Built the frontend of a live booking platform with two reservation flows: suites and workspaces.
Developed dynamic booking calendars, availability management, and end-to-end reservation flows.
Integrated the Nexi payment gateway for secure online payments.
Connected IoT control systems so guests can manage smart apartment features from the interface.
Structured the app with Next.js routing and a server/client component split for an optimised frontend.

projects.name: Luca Stay — Admin Dashboard
projects.subtitle: Back-office management
projects.description: Back-office dashboard to manage reservations, buildings, apartments, and services.
highlights: Built the back-office dashboard for Luca Stay to manage reservations, buildings, apartments, and services from one interface.
Used React Query for data fetching and caching, and a modular architecture to keep each management area isolated and easy to extend.

projects.name: Karat
projects.subtitle: Digital Gold Dashboard
projects.description: Dashboard for a digital gold platform covering buying, selling, and gifting flows with full financial management.
highlights: Built a dashboard for a digital gold platform covering three flows: buying, selling, and gifting gold.
Implemented full financial management for each flow, giving admins clear visibility into transactions and balances.
Organised the codebase into feature modules with typed data layers (TypeScript) and React Query for server state.
